page: Microsoft Azure NC288lds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a specialized GPU-accelerated server instance designed for high-density compute, large-scale visualization, and graphics-intensive parallel processing. Built on an x86_64 architecture using Intel processors managed via Microsoft Hyper-V, the server provides 288 dedicated vCPUs alongside 516.0 GB of system RAM. With approximately 1.79 GB of memory per core, the architecture designates this model within the low-memory category relative to its massive vCPU scale, prioritizing core count over expansive RAM allocation.

Hardware acceleration is powered by 2 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPUs based on the Blackwell architecture, supplying a total of 192 GB of dedicated GPU VRAM. In addition to GPU acceleration, the instance includes 15,943 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage configurations, offering substantial high-speed scratch space for datasets directly adjacent to the compute engines.

From a workload fit perspective, the dense core count, combined 192 GB of GPU VRAM, and high-capacity NVMe storage make this instance suited for large-scale GPU computing, 3D rendering pipelines, digital content creation, computer-aided engineering, and AI inference or fine-tuning workflows where high local throughput and graphics acceleration are critical.
